description: Call this only while setting up the server that receives the webhook of a form and needs the full signing secret; get_webhook shows the URL and a masked secret and is enough for anything else. Returns the full webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Requires an account key (fh_live_...); agent keys answer owner_key_required. Store the secret on the receiving server as a server-side secret. Never print it in chat or commit it.

form_id.description: The 10-character form_id returned by publish_form or list_forms, such as "abcDEF1234".

name: reveal_webhook_secret

error.description: Machine-readable error code or message when the call failed.

title: Reveal the webhook signing secret
